---
name: implement-issue
description: Implement a GitHub issue end-to-end
tools: github/*, figma/*
---

Steps:

1. Read the GitHub Issue
2. Extract requirements
3. Create an implementation plan
4. Generate components
5. Integrate components into the Next.js page
6. Ensure TypeScript compatibility
7. Ensure UI follows the Figma design

Output format:

## Plan

## Files Created

## Code Implementation
